Job Description – Assistant Vice President (AVP), Investment Banking – Equity
Location:surat
Experience: 5+ Years
Position Summary
We are looking for an experienced Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Investment Banking (Equity) to play a key role across business development, transaction execution, sector coverage, and investor/client relationship management. The role requires the ability to independently originate, lead, execute, and close transactions while building strong relationships across the investment ecosystem.
Key Responsibilities
• Business Development: Develop client networks, originate new opportunities, and drive client acquisition.
• Client & Investor Relationships: Build and manage long-term relationships with clients, investors, and other key stakeholders.
• Sector Coverage: Independently manage sector coverage, develop deep sector knowledge, and generate new business.
• Transaction Execution: Work across transactions from initial client pitches through execution and closing, including equity transactions, M&A, and strategic advisory assignments.
• Deal Leadership: Independently manage investor outreach, pitches, negotiations, third-party advisors, definitive documentation, and transaction closure.
• Strategic Advisory: Effectively communicate financial, regulatory, valuation, and strategic matters to clients and stakeholders.
Qualifications & Skills
• MBA in Finance/Economics, CA, CFA, or equivalent qualification preferred.
• Strong transaction execution and deal-closing capabilities.
• Strong financial modelling, accounting, and business valuation skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong understanding of valuation methodologies, including comparable company/transaction analysis and DCF.
• Ability to independently manage transactions and lead/mentor teams.
Experience & Requirements
• 5+ years of experience with an investment bank or private equity advisory firm.
• Strong transaction experience across multiple transaction types.
• Experience managing client relationships and day-to-day transaction execution.
• Existing exposure/network within the Venture Capital and Private Equity ecosystem in India.
• Ability to multitask and work effectively in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment.
• Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

5c9e6a6e87044597.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and analytically strong investment banking professional to join us in Emkay. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on exposure across Equity Capital Markets (ECM), Private Equity (PE), and Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) transactions, working closely with senior bankers, clients, investors, and advisors. The ideal candidate will possess strong financial modelling and valuation capabilities, a passion for deal execution, and the ability to leverage emerging AI tools to enhance research, analysis, and transaction management efficiency.

Role : Associate - Investment Banking
Location: Mumbai
Know about Emkay at www.emkayglobal.com 

Job Responsibilities
• Support execution of Equity Capital Markets (ECM), Private Equity (PE), and Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) transactions from origination through closure. 
• Assist in preparation of pitch books, investor presentations, information memorandums, management presentations, and other transaction-related materials. 
• Build and maintain financial models including DCF valuation, comparable company analysis, precedent transaction analysis, and other valuation methodologies. 
• Support due diligence, transaction documentation, and deal execution activities. 
• Coordinate with internal teams, clients, investors, legal advisors, auditors, and other stakeholders during transaction execution. 
• Analyze financial statements, business performance, and industry trends to support investment recommendations. 
• Leverage AI tools for desktop research, data mining, presentation creation, financial modelling support, and documentation of meeting notes and deal updates.
Skills
• Financial Modelling and Valuation 
• DCF Modelling
• Transaction Execution
• Investment Pitch Deck Preparation
• Strong understanding and practical application of AI tools 
Competencies:
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
• High attention to detail and accuracy 
• Excellent communication and presentation skills 
• Ability to manage multiple transactions and competing priorities
Qualification
• Postgraduate in Finance from a premier B-School (Tier-1 preferred), OR 
• Chartered Accountant (CA) First Attempt, OR 
• CFA (US) qualified 
Experience
• 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in ECM, Private Equity, Investment Banking, M&A, Corporate Finance, Deal Advisory, or Transaction Advisory. 
• Preference for candidates with end-to-end transaction exposure through deal closure. 
• Candidates from MNC KPOs or from domestic boutique investment banks, merchant banking firms, brokerage houses, etc
• Exposure to direct client interaction and deal execution activities preferred. 

This position is ideally suited for ambitious finance professionals looking to accelerate their careers in investment banking. The role provides exposure to complex transactions, direct client engagement, and end-to-end deal execution while fostering continuous learning in traditional financial analysis and next-generation AI-enabled workflows. Candidates who thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance environment and demonstrate exceptional analytical rigor, attention to detail, and execution excellence will find significant opportunities for growth and advancement.
